Select molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds in document CHEMBL2203023. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return all rows including those without structures. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
